name: Admah
overview: Admah was a city located in the vale of Siddim, mentioned alongside Sodom, Gomorrah, and Zeboim as part of the Canaanite territory (Genesis 10:19). It had a king named Shinab who participated in a war against the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah (Genesis 14:2). Scripture records that Admah was destroyed by the LORD's judgment, along with Sodom and Gomorrah, as a consequence of divine wrath, resulting in a land barren and burned with brimstone and salt (Deuteronomy 29:23). The prophet Hosea uses Admah as a symbol of God's judgment and mercy, expressing His reluctance to abandon Israel to such a fate (Hosea 11:8).
